prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Substantial new redraw of a single medieval dialogue HEAD portrait for a logical 74 x 100 pixel slot. Portrait ratio exactly 74:100, genuinely transparent background. Input 1 is identity reference ONLY: preserve this person's identity, sex, hair arrangement and clothes colors, never the chibi proportions or huge white eyes. Inputs 2-5 are the four approved core style references ONLY, never borrow their face identity.
Draw deliberately as a 74x100 low-resolution portrait enlarged by integer nearest-neighbor. Large connected HARD ANGULAR PIXEL CLUSTERS, about 2-8 logical pixels each, no smooth painted shading. Four or five large skin planes only, with a strong carved nose bridge/nose tip, cheekbone and jaw; matte muted palette, maximum 32 working colors. Hair in 3-4 broad connected masses, no thin hair strokes, striped locks or fleck texture. Warm upper-left light, umber shadow. No antialiasing, gradients, blur, dithering, tiny wrinkles, soft airbrush or realistic skin grain.
VERY TIGHT LARGE FACE head-only framing: three-quarter head turned slightly toward image-left, whole crown around y=3, eyebrows near y=35, chin around y=88, barely visible short neck, just a NARROW COLLAR BAND at y=93-99. FACE DOMINATES. No chest, torso, hands or full shoulders. Crucially keep complete crown, hair/headwrap and visible ear silhouette with 2-3 logical pixels transparent space at top and both sides. Do not cut the top or the ear.
Small narrow eyes under weighty lids, dark brown pupils and only low-contrast ochre/taupe sclera, zero white eye blocks or catchlights. No huge black eyeliner. Closed mouth. Individual strong bone structure and expression. No text, labels, props, weapons, insignia, frame, scene or watermark.
Subject: WEIYU (薇榆), a WOMAN AROUND FIFTY, meticulous paper-fragment SCRIBE. Preserve old identity: dark brown swept side-parted hair gathered into a LOW BUN behind the visible ear, two large connected side locks, narrower long mature cheekbones and gently squared chin, long defined nose, warm muted complexion. Make her recognizably about fifty using broad eyelid, cheek and nasolabial planes, NOT noisy wrinkle strokes and NOT youthful anime. Expression: CLOSE ATTENTIVE SCRUTINY, one eyebrow subtly raised asymmetrically toward its OUTER end while the other is straight and low; mouth thin CLOSED and slightly compressed, she is quietly checking an assertion, not sad, not worried, not glaring. Eyes small and concentrated, no bright whites. Keep low hair bun complete in frame, but compact so face stays huge. At very bottom a thin muted DARK TEAL scribe smock collar, slim off-white linen edge and a tiny BROWN wool shawl edge. She only knows her batch of fragments: no writing, open pages, private names, burning boxes or claim that corrections are completed. Distinguish her narrow thoughtful face from the broad square-faced caregiver Tiver.
